translations.web: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
translations.bsb: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
translations.kjv: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
translations.asv: He will judge the poor of the people, He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.
